text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate (502/504) observed in inference-gateway-us-east-1. Spikes correlated with prefix-KV prefetch lag on kv-pool-12. Auto-page sent to oncall. :rotating_light:

elena (oncall): I’m on it. Seeing large tail latencies on gateway -> kv reads, timeouts around 250ms -> cascade 502s. Routing to backup pool failing sometimes.

pj: can you paste the top logs? I’m checking the kv metrics.

elena (oncall): log snippets from gateway 
```
2026-03-15T14:22:11Z gateway ERR read timeout from kv://kv-pool-12/prefix-lookup (deadline exceeded)
2026-03-15T14:22:12Z gateway WARN fallback read triggered -> miss -> upsync
2026-03-15T14:22:13Z model-proxy ERR 502 upstream kv timeout
```

maria: kv-pool-12 prefetch queue length jumped 12x at 14:21. Background prefetch worker stuck on a shard with >200 pending keys. Suspect prefetch backpressure + eviction churn.

jordan: seeing correlated increase in cache evictions around that time: TTL enforcement + concurrent compaction. Possibly compaction tasks blocking prefetch threads.

elena (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily disable prefetch on kv-pool-12, 2) increase gateway read timeout to avoid 502s for a short window, 3) route new requests to kv-pool-8/9. Preference: disable prefetch first. Thoughts?

pj: agree. Disable prefetch on kv-pool-12, and scale up pool-8 reads by +20%. Also enable bypass for enterprise-account-42 which reported highest error rate.

ops-bot: runbook step triggered by elena: `kvctl set-prefetch --pool kv-pool-12 --state disabled`

incident-bot: Runbook action acknowledged by system.

elena (oncall): done: prefetch disabled. Watching metrics now.

sre-pager: traffic rerouted to kv-pool-8 as requested. Gateway read-timeout bump to 800ms applied to edge rule for 10m.

support: Customer-impact summary for CSMs: enterprise-account-42 saw ~40% request failures between 14:21-14:30 UTC, most requests returned 502. Small number of other customers saw latency increases. No data loss; retries succeeded for many requests after 2-3 attempts.

maria: after disabling prefetch, prefetch queue drains slowly. Eviction rate normalized and 502 spike dropped. KV error-rate graph: 14:22 spike -> 14:26 downward trend.

pj: note: prefetch disabled removes some cache-hit optimizations; expect short-term CPU increase on model-proxies as more misses hit origin. Monitoring CPU and cost.

elena (oncall): live mitigation status: prefetch disabled ✅, read-timeout increased ✅, traffic partially rerouted ✅. 502 rate down from 6.4% -> 0.9% in 8 minutes.

jordan: we should perform safe rollback of the recent compaction change that coincided with the event. Tagging the git hash. If we rollback compaction patch, re-enable prefetch after verifying compaction behaves.

pj: agreed. Schedule rollback to canary first. elena, do you want me to run canary rollback?

elena (oncall): yes please. Canary on kv-pool-10 only. If stable for 5m, promote.

ops-bot: `deployctl rollback --service kv-compaction --env canary --target kv-pool-10 --reason "prefetch-induced stalls causing 502s"` executed.

incident-bot: Canary rollback completed on kv-pool-10. Health checks passed.

maria: after rollback canary, compaction latency dropped 3x on kv-pool-10. re-enable prefetch on pool-10 for validation only.

elena (oncall): good. We'll keep prefetch disabled on pool-12 until compaction fix is rolled everywhere. Current plan: 1) finish staged rollback across pools over next 30m, 2) re-enable prefetch per-pool after stability window, 3) postmortem to analyze prefetch backpressure and add circuit-breaker to prefetch worker.

support: Noted. Communicated interim mitigation to affected CSMs. No major SLAs breached but some enterprise retries required.

pj: adding monitoring alerts: prefetch queue length > 50 for >2min -> auto-disable prefetch and notify oncall. Also adding metric for compaction blocking time.

elena (oncall): handoff to night oncall @jordan in 35m. I'll update the incident channel with the mitigation steps and current state.

jordan: ack. I’ll take over monitoring and continue the staged rollback. Keep me posted if error rate creeps up.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (partial). Severity: Sev3 -> monitoring. Actions: staged rollback in progress, prefetch circuit-breaker planned.

elena (oncall): final note before handoff: key customer list attached in ticket #INC-20260315-42; recommend outreach to top 3 impacted accounts. Logging full timeline for postmortem.

support: preparing customer-facing blurb for CSMs: "We experienced elevated gateway errors due to an internal cache prefetch backlog; mitigations applied and normal service restored. We will follow up with root cause and remediation steps." :thumbsup: 

jordan: taking over. Closing pager to elena. Thanks everyone.

sre-pager: pager cleared for elena.

incident-bot: Thread will remain open for postmortem notes.
